findings.title: TableWidgetVisualization receives hardcoded empty data
findings.body: When the `use-table-widget-visualization` feature flag is enabled, `TableWidgetVisualization` is rendered with `columns={[]}` and `tableData={{data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}}` instead of the actual `fields`, `result.data`, and `result.meta` from the `tableResults.map(...)` iteration. The local variables `fields`, `result.data`, and `result.meta` are computed in the surrounding closure (used by the fallback `StyledSimpleTableChart` branch) but the new branch passes literals, so any user with the flag enabled will see empty tables in dashboards regardless of the underlying query data. This appears to be an incomplete refactor that will cause silent breakage of dashboard table widgets for opted-in users.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature flag check
findings.body: The endpoint records the `preprod_artifact.api.assemble` analytics event before checking whether the `organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble` feature flag is enabled for the organization. Denied requests (where the feature flag is off) still record analytics, which will inflate the event count and any dashboards/metrics derived from it. If the intent is to measure usage of the feature itself, the call should be moved after the `features.has(...)` check or gated on the flag.

findings.title: Analytics event key renamed without backward compatibility
findings.body: The analytics event key tracked in the replay breadcrumb is renamed from `replay.view_html` to `replay.view-html`. Any existing dashboards, alerts, BI queries, or external consumers referencing `replay.view_html` will silently stop receiving data and continue to fail without error feedback. The `replayAnalyticsEvents.tsx` map is updated to the new key but the old key is not kept as an alias. If the rename is intentional, callers should be informed (e.g., a deprecation period where both keys are emitted) so dashboards do not silently break.

findings.title: Public API `ParameterizationRegexExperiment` removed
findings.body: The `ParameterizationRegexExperiment` class is removed from the module and from `__all__`. Any downstream code (including external Sentry forks/plugins) importing `ParameterizationRegexExperiment` from `sentry.grouping.parameterization` will fail with `ImportError`. The corresponding tests were also deleted. If this class was part of a supported extension point for grouping strategies, its removal should be documented or done behind a deprecation cycle.

findings.title: No test for new analytics event registration
findings.body: The new `PreprodArtifactApiAssembleEvent` analytics event is registered at module import time without any test asserting that it is registered (e.g., no equivalent of `analytics.events` containment check) or that the endpoint actually emits it. Combined with the fact that the endpoint records analytics before the feature flag check, this means a regression in event registration or payload shape could go undetected.
